_: Per-tile classes drawn as a recolor of another class until they get art of their own: the Deepworks' Clayworks (3), Crystal (4) and Starfall (5) floors and walls, from the Earth (0) and Frost (1) tiles. The Crystal's and Starfall's specks sit one step down their ramps (2.1.2): at full brightness the floor outshone the ore, the pests and Starfall's gold shard marks; Starfall keeps a few gold glints per tile. make-recipe.mjs copies this into the recipe, terrain-import.mjs into the sheet's manifest.
